crossRefs.note: Afterward all the children of Israel came near, and he gave them all the commandments that Yahweh had spoken with him…
Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven; but he who does the will of my Father…
For it isn’t the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the law will be justified
But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.

parallels.note: Moses said to the congregation, “This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded to be done.”

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses assembled all the congregation of the children of Israel, and said to them, “These are the words which Yahweh has commanded, that you should do them.
translations.bsb: Then Moses assembled the whole congregation of Israel and said to them, “These are the things that the LORD has commanded you to do:
translations.kjv: And Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Israel together, and said unto them, These are the words which the LORD hath commanded, that ye should do
translations.asv: And Moses assembled all the congregation of the children of Israel, and said unto them, These are the words which Jehovah hath commanded, that ye should do them.
